pages.title: Row ten, screen four · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday night, and the cinema in Denver is busy. Ana comes with her friend Lisa. They want to see a comedy. A big poster shows a man with a funny hat. At the box office, a clerk named Ray smiles at them. The line is short, so Ana walks up.
“Good evening! What film do you want to see?” says Ray. “I like comedy films. What is playing?” says Ana. “There is a funny one at eight o’clock.” says Ray.
